Older approach — Filter is primary in production
— powers Open WebUI Knowledge Base RAG (document uploads, chunking, similarity search)
OPEN WEBUI KNOWLEDGE BASE RAG (built-in naive RAG)
Admin uploads docs → chunk (1,500 tokens) → embed (sentence-transformers) → store in ChromaDB
Similarity search → top-k retrieval → context injected into LLM prompt (used alongside GraphRAG)
Dual retrieval: GraphRAG (Neo4j, structured) + KB RAG (ChromaDB, document uploads)
Proxies through Open WebUI GraphRAG pipeline
Bundled with Open WebUI in Docker
Powers KB RAG (upload → chunk → embed → search)
git clone → python apply-patches.py → docker compose up -d --build
